nodes.label: Codel full logo (white)
nodes.description: Full 'codel' wordmark lockup (viewBox 671.68x117.31), same three paths, filled white #ffffff.
nodes.rationale: Default logo for the dark-first site: white on dark grounds. Per CLAUDE.md it is also the artwork centred on --bg #101411 in the 1200x630 share image public/brand/og.png, which must be re-rendered if this file changes.

nodes.label: Codel Latin wordmark letterforms (d, e, l)
nodes.description: Second and third paths of the full logos: a 'd' built from a rounded bowl and a short slanted stem, an 'e' made of three stacked slanted bars, and an 'l' made of a slanted stem and a foot bar. Stems lean about 10 degrees (for example dx 20.78 over dy 117.31).
nodes.rationale: The wordmark is Latin only; there is no Arabic wordmark, so the site writes كودل as live text. Do not retype or recreate the letters.

nodes.label: Codel full logo, white
nodes.rationale: White variant of the full Latin wordmark, for dark grounds; not to be recoloured, stretched, redrawn or retyped.
